page: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance configured with dual NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs delivering 64 GB of aggregate VRAM. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6226R processor operating at 2.9 GHz, the system provides 30 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading. Memory is configured at 90 GB of RAM, offering 3.0 GB per core. The instance includes a 500 GB local NVMe SSD for fast storage scratch space and a baseline network throughput of 4 Gbps, managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional capability in machine learning tasks, placing the instance in the top 10% tier for large language model inference across 135M, 7B, and 70B parameter models. Prompt processing throughput reaches 17,320.17 tokens per second on 135M models and 151.96 tokens per second on 70B models, while text generation achieves 18.65 tokens per second on 70B models. Memory operations and multi-threaded decompression tests such as bzip3 benchmark in the top 25% tier. Conversely, general-purpose CPU scores, including Geekbench and PassMark CPU metrics, align with the median 50% tier of comparable platforms.

From an architectural standpoint, the t2-le-90 prioritizes hardware accelerator density over extreme general memory sizing. Limitations include a fixed 500 GB local storage volume, absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and a 4 Gbps baseline network ceiling. The hardware profile is targeted toward deep learning inference, batch model evaluation, GPU-accelerated parallel numerical processing, and scientific simulation workloads.
description: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a dedicated GPU instance engineered for compute-heavy parallel workloads and machine learning tasks. Built on an x86_64 architecture, the system is equipped with 30 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6226R processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, paired with 90 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by dual NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs delivering a cumulative 64 GB of VRAM. Storage consists of a local 500 GB NVMe SSD, backed by a 4 Gbps network baseline. Performance benchmarks highlight top-tier capabilities in large language model inference, achieving strong prompt evaluation rates across 135M, 7B, and 70B parameter models. Multi-core compression and general CPU benchmarks remain balanced within the median tier. With dedicated core allocations and dedicated dual-GPU hardware, the t2-le-90 serves deep learning inference, numerical modeling, and GPU-assisted scientific computing.
